why: HELD, and the reason is an artifact of STACKING that is worth stating rather than working around. This PR is based on claude/e20-lane-cost-supervision (PR #12742), so its diff AGAINST main contains that branch's commits, including .github/pr-landing/e20-lane-cost-supervision.json and .github/pr-landing/e28-ict-scalp-harness-route.json. pr-landing-guard R12 reads the diff against origin/main and correctly refuses a self-land over them. THIS PR'S OWN diff (against its base) changes no landing machinery at all -- but 'trust me, it is the stacking' is exactly the argument R12 exists to refuse, since the change and its own approval would be the same act. So it is held for one human read. Once #12742 merges and GitHub retargets this PR to main, the R12 finding should clear on its own and self-land can be re-declared. E44: the lane supervisor. Extends E20's scripts/ops/lane_reconcile.py (this PR is STACKED on claude/e20-lane-cost-supervision, so its diff is only the E44 files) with two modes and adds one doc. --supervise emits an ARCHIVE PLAN gated on five conditions where a condition that could not be EVALUATED HOLDS: an absent open-PR listing, an absent Routine listing, or a checklist naming no supervisor each authorise NOTHING and exit 2, because 'we could not look' is not 'there is none'. --heartbeat-grade grades the supervisor's OWN liveness in five never-collapsed states and is what CI runs, so if the supervisor stops, the receipt goes stale and every PR reds within 18h. docs/claude/work/LANE-SUPERVISOR-MANDATE.md is the supervisor's committed contract, registered in DOCUMENT-INDEX.md with its header matching the generated row. Tier-1 by the canonical doc's own list and verifiable against the diff: scripts/ops/lane_reconcile.py (ops tooling, READ-ONLY -- it writes nothing, archives nothing, makes no network call and is wired into no runtime path; it emits a PLAN a session then acts on), scripts/ci/run_guards.py (one guard entry), docs/claude/work/LANE-SUPERVISOR-MANDATE.md (new doc), docs/DOCUMENT-INDEX.md (one row), docs/claude/work/LANE-SUPERVISOR-HEARTBEAT.json (a receipt the supervisor writes), and the landing/arming files the self-land route requires. NO src/, no config/, no deploy/, no .github/workflows/, no order path, no strategy params, no risk caps, no runtime behaviour, no DB write. It touches no live trading surface at all.
